title: The Reign and Fall of King Uzziah
description: Uzziah becomes king of Judah at the age of sixteen and reigns for 52 years. As long as he seeks the Lord, God gives him success: he defeats the Philistines, Arabs, and Meunites, strengthens Jerusalem, and builds a large army. But when he has become powerful, he becomes proud and enters the temple to burn incense on the altar of incense. The priest Azariah and eighty other priests confront him, and while he is raging, leprosy breaks out on his forehead. He remains leprous until his death, while his son Jotham rules the land.
